posts.name: Prashant Negi
posts.cooked:
There is a slight misinterpretation this time. Usually it’s like 2024-08-21, 23:59 IST, which means 21st is the last day. But this time, it’s like 2024-08-21, 00:00 IST. Which means yesterday (20th) was the last day for submission.

Thank You
